features.name: Qwen3-4B QLoRA finetune notebook
features.description: Unsloth QLoRA SFT notebook for Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct: combined+shuffled SFT, r=16, seq 2048, 1 epoch, train_on_responses_only; saves LoRA and GGUF q4_k_m. Runs on Kaggle T4; model choice justified against Phi-4-mini, Llama-3.2-3B, Gemma-3, SmolLM3-3B.

tests.notes: No separate harness (needs GPU + gitignored data) — the notebook asserts for itself: non-degenerate source counts, zero blank/NaN turns, qwen_lora/ written. Verified out-of-repo with stubbed unsloth/model: 2775 CounselChat - 163 blank and 3512 Amod - 4 blank -> 6120 examples; save cell without HF_TOKEN saves qwen_lora/ and skips both pushes; disabling the blank filter makes the notebook's own assert fire.

features.name: MentalBench-Align evaluation harness
features.description: Automated counselling-quality evaluation using the MentalBench-Align repo (CSS = Guidance/Informativeness/Relevance/Safety; ARS = Empathy/Helpfulness/Understanding) with its 1–5 rubrics plus judge prompt and JSON schema, including a human spot-check on Safety/Relevance.
features.notes: Caveat: LLM judges inflate affective scores by +0.4–0.8 and are weakest on Safety/Relevance.

features.name: MentalBench-100k Qwen3-4B baseline
features.description: Generate a fresh Qwen3-4B baseline over MentalBench-100k (10k rows) on Kaggle T4 fp16 with the paper's generation prompt, enable_thinking=False, temp 0.7 / top_p 0.8, max 512 tokens. Two shard kernels write idx,context,qwen3_4b_instruct_2507 CSVs.

tests.notes: Not in repo — kernel outputs in data/eval/mbench-qwen3-4b-baseline/output_shard_a.csv (906 rows, idx 0-905) and output_shard_b.csv (875 rows, idx 5000-5874); gitignored, like the finetune data.

subtasks.name: Push v2 kernels with aligned metadata slugs
Fetch both shard outputs and merge
Judge pass with a current API model

features.notes: Kernels eros438/ai-therapist-qwen3-mbench-{a-rows-0-5000,b-rows-5000-10000} both CANCEL_ACKNOWLEDGED (killed at the 9h cap). Outputs (2026-10-14): shard A 906 rows idx 0-905, shard B 875 rows idx 5000-5874, no gaps/dupes, 0 empty, 1781/10000 = 18% coverage. Rate ~35-37 s/row (~100 rows/h/kernel), so a full 5000-row shard needs ~50 GPU-h — unbatched single-stream fp16 generation is the bottleneck; batched or vLLM sampling is required to finish. Resume works only if the partial CSV is re-attached as an input dataset (both runs logged resume skipped=0 on a fresh /kaggle/working). 50% of the 1781 responses are cut mid-sentence at the 512-token cap — caveat for the judge pass. Paper's GPT-4o/Claude-3.7/Gemini-2.5 judges are deprecated; their stored Qwen-3 scores are NOT reusable, so a fresh baseline is required (needs API keys + budget).
